# Data Model: YAML Repository

**Branch**: `007-yaml-repository` | **Date**: 2026-02-24

## Overview

This feature introduces no new domain entities. `YAMLRepository` stores the existing domain objects (`Category`, `Item`, `Tag`, `CategoryParentLink`, `ItemParentLink`, `ItemTagLink`) in a YAML file using the same structural schema as `JsonRepository`.

This document specifies the **YAML on-disk schema** — the serialized representation of domain objects.

---

## YAML File Top-Level Structure

```yaml
# taxomesh.yaml — generated by YAMLRepository
# Human-readable; do not add YAML tags or custom types.

categories:     # dict[str, Category dict]   — keyed by UUID string
  <uuid>:
    category_id: <uuid string>
    name: <str, max 256 chars>
    description: <str | null, max 100000 chars>

items:          # dict[str, Item dict]       — keyed by UUID string
  <uuid>:
    item_id: <uuid string>
    external_id: <str, max 512 chars>
    enabled: <bool>
    description: <str | null, max 100000 chars>

tags:           # dict[str, Tag dict]        — keyed by UUID string
  <uuid>:
    tag_id: <uuid string>
    name: <str, max 256 chars>

item_tag_links:           # list[ItemTagLink dict]
- tag_id: <uuid string>
  item_id: <uuid string>

category_parent_links:    # list[CategoryParentLink dict]
- category_id: <uuid string>
  parent_category_id: <uuid string>
  sort_index: <int ≥ 0>

item_parent_links:        # list[ItemParentLink dict]
- item_id: <uuid string>
  category_id: <uuid string>
  sort_index: <int ≥ 0>
```

---

## Serialization Rules

| Rule | Detail |
|------|--------|
| UUID values | Always serialized as plain strings (no YAML UUID tags) |
| Null fields | Serialized as `null` (YAML native null) |
| Boolean fields | Serialized as `true` / `false` (YAML native bool) |
| Integer fields | Serialized as plain integers |
| Top-level keys | Always present even if empty (empty dict `{}` or empty list `[]`) |
| Missing top-level key on read | Treated as empty collection; no error |
| Empty file on read | Treated as empty taxonomy; no error |
| YAML flow style | Block style (`default_flow_style=False`) |
| Unicode | Allowed (`allow_unicode=True`) — supports non-ASCII names |
| Key sort | Insertion order preserved (`sort_keys=False`) |

---

## Validation Rules (on load)

| Condition | Behaviour |
|-----------|-----------|
| File does not exist | Create empty file; start with empty collections |
| File is a directory | Raise `TaxomeshRepositoryError` immediately at init |
| File exists, empty content | Treat as empty taxonomy; no error |
| File exists, invalid YAML | Raise `TaxomeshRepositoryError` with file path + parse error |
| Top-level value is not a dict | Raise `TaxomeshRepositoryError` |
| Individual record fails Pydantic validation | Raise `TaxomeshRepositoryError` (wrapped) |

---

## Domain Entity Reference (unchanged)

These entities are defined in `taxomesh/domain/models.py`. The YAML adapter serializes them identically to the JSON adapter via `Model.model_dump(mode="json")`.

| Entity | Key fields | Notes |
|--------|-----------|-------|
| `Category` | `category_id: UUID`, `name: str[256]`, `description: str[100000] | None` | Reserved name `__root__` for root category |
| `Item` | `item_id: UUID`, `external_id: str[512]`, `enabled: bool`, `description: str[100000] | None` | |
| `Tag` | `tag_id: UUID`, `name: str[256]` | |
| `CategoryParentLink` | `category_id: UUID`, `parent_category_id: UUID`, `sort_index: int` | One row per (child, parent) pair |
| `ItemParentLink` | `item_id: UUID`, `category_id: UUID`, `sort_index: int` | Upsert on (item_id, category_id) |
| `ItemTagLink` | `tag_id: UUID`, `item_id: UUID` | Association table; idempotent |
